description: This PHP source file defines the NewsSubController class within the Goteo application's admin controller namespace. It manages CRUD and administrative actions for news items, including listing, adding, editing, translating, and managing press banners. It includes permission checks, form handling, and interaction with the Goteo model layer.

classes.name: NewsSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing administrative news operations, including CRUD, translation, ordering, and media handling within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access this controller based on node configuration and roles.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles translation actions for news items, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing or creating news items, processing form submissions or displaying the form.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a news item up in the order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a news item down in the order.

methods.name: add_press_bannerAction
methods.description: Associates a press banner with a news item.

methods.name: remove_press_bannerAction
methods.description: Removes a press banner from a news item.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists news items or related entities.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main handler for various news-related actions, including CRUD operations, ordering, and media management.
